item.name: 🔐 Authentication
item.description: All authentication endpoints. Start here - run 'Direct Login (Testing)' first to get your access token.

exec: console.log('✅ Tokens saved to collection variables');

request.description:
⚠️ This calls Keycloak directly for testing purposes.
In production, use the OAuth2 authorization code flow.

After running this, the access token is automatically saved.
Returns the Keycloak login URL. Redirect the user to this URL to start OAuth2 flow.
Step 2 of OAuth flow. Exchange the authorization code for tokens.
Get a new access token using the refresh token. Call this before access token expires (every ~4 minutes).
Invalidates the session in Keycloak. The refresh token will no longer work.
Returns current user info decoded from the JWT token.
Returns the current user's organization details including storage usage.

request.description:
Create a shareable link for a document.

Permission levels:
- view: Can only view the document
- download: Can view and download
- edit: Can view, download, and edit metadata

Set isPublic:true for anyone-with-link access.
Set isPublic:false to restrict to specific users.

Soft-delete a document. The file is NOT immediately removed from storage.
A background cleanup worker handles the actual file deletion.

Editor: can only delete their own documents
Admin/Owner: can delete any document
